subject: Mutual Delivery Agreement (90-day) & Next steps
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Kim <alyssa.kim@vertex-analytics.com>, Victor Huang <victor.huang@vertex-analytics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2029 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Delivery Agreement (90-day) & Next steps

Hi Alyssa / Victor —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, I put together a compact Mutual Delivery Agreement (MAP) and a 90-day implementation timeline so we can lock owners, milestone dates, and acceptance criteria. Attachment: Vertex_MAP_90d.xlsx contains the milestone table, owner rows, and a brief risk register. I also attached a first-pass SOW for legal to review.

High-level summary (please confirm):
- Phase 0 (Week 0–2): Kickoff & access — create staging environment access, share network diagram, complete compliance questionnaire. Owner: Vertex (Alyssa).
- Phase 1 (Weeks 2–6): Integrations & ingestion — S3 transfer, sample data validation, embedding pipeline. Owner: Redwood SE (Ben).
- Phase 2 (Weeks 6–10): Model tuning & safety checks — prompt sets, eval pass/fail gates, latency tuning. Owner: Redwood CS (Soojin) with Karthik supporting infra.
- Phase 3 (Weeks 10–12): UAT & production readiness — smoke tests, runbook, cutover window. Owner: Vertex + Redwood on-call.

Immediate asks (can you confirm by Wednesday?):
1) Confirm the kickoff window — we proposed Tue 28 May or Thu 30 May (see sheet).
2) Any conflicts on owners above or proposed milestone dates?
3) Alyssa — can you confirm the compliance questionnaire owner and timeline?

Attachments included: Vertex_MAP_90d.xlsx (implementation plan), SOW-draft-Vertex-v1.pdf (draft).

I'll consolidate any feedback and publish the canonical MAP to the shared doc.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

---
Redwood Inference | Production-first inference platform | soojin.lee@redwood.ai

Thanks, Soojin — this is very helpful. Quick notes:

- Kickoff: Thu 30 May works best for us (10:00am PT). Please lock that if it works for the Redwood team.
- Phase 0: For the compliance questionnaire, our security lead (Victor) will own completing the questionnaire, but I'll be the point for follow-ups. Victor noted a possible constraint: we need the network diagram and list of IP ranges before 30 May.
- Phase 1 dates: can we shift ingestion validation to finish by Week 5 instead of Week 6? We have a holiday week in Week 6.

I'll ask legal to review the SOW and circle back with specific redlines. Otherwise looks good.

Best,
Alyssa Kim
Head of AI Ops
Vertex Analytics

- Confirmed kickoff: Thu 30 May 10:00am PT (I'll send the calendar invite once Soojin confirms Redwood attendees).
- Owners adjustments: move ingestion validation completion to end of Week 5 (new target).
- Karthik — can you send the network diagram and IP whitelist by EOD Wed 29 May? I'll attach a v1 network diagram here for visibility.

Thanks — noted on Phase 1 owner. A couple technical notes for the kickoff so we can scope the ingestion sprint properly:

- Staging access: we will need a temporary S3 bucket (read), plus a temporary API key for the test cluster. Alyssa, can you confirm who on your side will create the bucket and provide the key?
- Smoke test: propose a 2-hour SE-led smoke window on Day 1 of Phase 3 to run the acceptance checks Monica listed. I can draft the test script and checklist.
- Security: if Vertex requires an IP allowlist, please include the expected CIDR ranges; otherwise we'll use VPN tunneling for the initial transfer.

I'll attach the SE checklist to the shared MAP once Monica publishes it.

Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Alyssa / Victor / team — thanks for the quick responses. Per the thread and internal confirmations, I've: 

- Locked kickoff: Thu 30 May, 10:00am PT (calendar invite sent to all).
- Updated MAP with owners and new Week-5 target for ingestion validation. The canonical MAP is here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD_Map_90d/edit (published).
- Monica uploaded the network-diagram.png and Karthik confirmed he will deliver the IP whitelist by EOD Wed 29 May.
- Ben will own the SE smoke test and draft checklist; Ben, please add the checklist to the shared doc by Mon 27 May.

Next steps for everyone before kickoff: 
- Alyssa / Victor: confirm who will provision the staging S3 and temporary API key (needed for Phase 1).
- Victor: complete the compliance questionnaire by 29 May.
- Ben: draft SE smoke checklist by 27 May.
- Monica: publish the final MAP and attach the SOW for legal review.

If there are no objections, this will be our canonical plan for the 90-day rollout. I'll keep the HubSpot deal updated: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/987654321/DEAL-2209-VA

Thanks — excited to get started.

Best,
